bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that quantifies discrepancies in model predictions across sensitive subgroups using group fairness metrics such as Statistical Parity and Equal Opportunity.
Surveying literature that evaluates whether similar individuals receive similar algorithmic outcomes, measured via ranking similarity metrics like NDCG@k and ERR@k across input and output spaces.
Surveying literature that evaluates performance disparities (e.g., predictive accuracy) in graph neural networks between high-degree (well-connected) nodes and low-degree (sparsely connected) nodes.
